evidence.note: This company lifecycle disclosure supports environmental burdens attributable to generative AI, including server manufacture. It does not establish speculative overbuilding.
Duplicated requests and inflated demand projections indicate speculative planning, but do not establish excessive construction.

Capacity constraints and strong leasing demand weigh against a general overbuilding inference. The combined market does not isolate generative-AI utilization or substantiate demand for the relevant facilities.
Institutional reporting supports environmental risks from current AI infrastructure siting. Modeled impacts and mitigation possibilities do not establish excessive generative-AI construction.

reviews.rationale: The packet supports environmental burdens and siting risks, but does not connect environmentally consequential generative-AI construction to demand exceeding credible commitments or projections. Speculative connection requests cannot supply that missing link; market scarcity and mitigation evidence also limit the inference.

The original paper confirms exclusion of physical work. It also excludes some AI-solvable writing categories, limiting the inference that expanding coverage would necessarily yield a substantially lower rate.

reviews.rationale: The reported maximum and physical-work exclusion are supported. The study measures selected end-to-end freelance projects, not all human tasks. Missing population weights and comparable measurements leave the claimed substantial overestimate unsettled; exclusion of AI-solvable writing further complicates the extrapolation.

The contemporaneous review documents simple reasoning failures and, as described in the packet, physical, spatial, and planning failures relevant to the behavioral reality criterion.

reviews.rationale: Contemporaneous evidence supports recurring hallucinations, elementary reasoning errors, and failures involving real-world constraints under the contract's fair behavioral reading. semantics.note: The preceding sentence supplies the AGI reference. The assertion is firm, retains the known-product scope, and supplies no deadline.

contract.note: Broad human-level competence is an ordinary reading of the AGI expectations. Requiring technical continuity and independent verification fairly constrains potential counterexamples; present shortcomings cannot establish permanent impossibility.

evidence.note: The dated company disclosure identifies a candidate advance. Its benchmark claims do not independently verify broad AGI-level fulfillment or establish continuity with the specified methods.
Independent benchmark results demonstrate substantial progress within bounded environments. The evaluator explicitly declines to infer AGI, so the early-resolution criterion is unmet.

reviews.rationale: No deadline was stated, and neither early-resolution event is established. The packet contains neither a valid impossibility result nor independently verified fulfillment of the broad promises by an in-scope product. Benchmark progress alone settles neither direction.
